laws.d: 15 SSRs, one plan. Secession is treason against the workers.
Taxes, seizures and trade flow to the state vault. Robbing Gosbank = heaviest heat.
-work shifts build the plan. Shock workers (most shifts) earn Stakhanovite prestige.
SSR Electoral College: 147 EV, 74 to win. One vote per Discord, confirmed in-server.
MVD + KGB/FCA inspect and seize. Heat decays only when you lay low.

steps: Join the Discord server (invite via Central Committee)
Pick your SSR — your work zone and resources follow it
-work daily to earn rubles, resources and shifts
Get hired by a state enterprise (-hire) or found one
Vote in SSR elections (!confirm CODE in Discord)
Serve: Army (-enlist), MVD patrols, KGB exams, ministries
